svg.aria-label: Fees go to Payers. A Receiver opens 10,000 dollars of exposure and later closes it. At 0.1 percent each way, 10 dollars to open and 10 dollars to close go to the Payer pool, 20 dollars per round trip. Over a year, 5,000 dollars of Payers backing 10,000 dollars of Receivers at 5 percent earn 250 dollars of their own interest, 500 dollars of the Receivers' interest and 20 dollars of fees per round trip, about 770 dollars or 15.4 percent.
svg.title: Fees go to Payers
